namespace = vmore

vmore.1 = {
	type = country_event
	trigger = {
		NOT = { any_owned_location = { exists = c:ENG } }
		exists = continent:europe
		exists = continent:asia
		exists = region:france_region
		exists = region:china_region
		exists = area:paris_area
		exists = area:thames_area
		exists = area:loire_area
		exists = sub_continent:western_europe
		exists = sub_continent:east_asia
		exists = region:britain_region
	}
	immediate = {
		every_owned_location = { add_prestige = 1 }
		c:FRA = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}
}
vmore.2 = {
	type = country_event
	trigger = { is_ai = yes }
}
